segments.an7.7:1.1: Atha kho uggo rājamahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uggo rājamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an7.7:2.2: Yāva aḍḍho cāyaṃ, bhante, migāro rohaṇeyyo yāva mahaddhano yāva mahābhogo”ti.
segments.an7.7:2.3: “Kīva aḍḍho panugga, migāro rohaṇeyyo, kīva mahaddhano, kīva mahābhogo”ti?
segments.an7.7:2.4: “Sataṃ, bhante, satasahassānaṃ [sahassānaṃ (sī.), sahassāni (syā.), satasahassāni (?)] hiraññassa, ko pana vādo rūpiyassā”ti!
segments.an7.7:2.5: “Atthi kho etaṃ, ugga, dhanaṃ netaṃ ‘natthī’ti vadāmīti.
segments.an7.7:2.6: Tañca kho etaṃ, ugga, dhanaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehi.
segments.an7.7:2.7: Satta kho imāni, ugga, dhanāni asādhāraṇāni agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehi.
segments.an7.7:2.9: Saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hirīdhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ.
segments.an7.7:2.10: Imāni kho, ugga, satta dhanāni asādhāraṇāni agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehīti.
segments.an7.7:3.3: Sutadhanañca cāgo ca, paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ.
segments.an7.7:4.1: “Yassa ete dhanā atthi, itthiyā purisassa vā;
segments.an7.7:4.3: Sa ve mahaddhano loke, ajeyyo devamānuse.

lines: Rūpiyassāti sesassa taṭṭakasarakaattharaṇapāvuraṇādino paribhogaparikkhārassa pamāṇasaṅkhāne vādoyeva natthi.
